The '''Spirana system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located near the [[Denon system/Legends|Denon system]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. One of the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] located in the system was [[Spirana/Legends|Spirana]]. In about [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sent a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to this system and liberated Spirana from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control.
